verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop SaaS with a Teams API, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server. The Teams API for automation is only a developer building block and earns no credit, and probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
